fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on a fatal causeway automobile crash involving Fred Osius and criticism of authorities for not filing charges; discussion of Miami Beach policing and the discharge of Detective George Christie; notes on municipal administration including the resignation of City Manager Wharton and calls for a capable city manager; commentary on transportation and traffic regulation impacts; discussion of harbor/wharfage charges affecting shipping; Fourth of July-related commentary and local events listings, along with sports coverage (boxing and baseball) and assorted columns, letters, and advertisements.
